rows.rationale: Keeps all three Tarshish mentions, both presence clauses, and repeated downward motion central to the narrative.
rows.before: But Jonah got up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish. He paid the fare and went down into the ship to go with them to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.
rows.after: Jonah got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the LORD’s presence. He went down to Joppa, found a ship bound for Tarshish, paid its fare, and went down aboard to travel with them to Tarshish, away from the LORD’s presence.
rows.tsw_comparator: But Jonah arose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the LORD. He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish. So he paid its fare and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.

rows.rationale: Preserves each sailor's god, cargo disposal, Jonah's further descent, and sleep contrast.
rows.before: The sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his god. They threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the inner part of the ship, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
rows.after: The sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his god. They hurled the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. Meanwhile Jonah had gone down into the hold, lain down, and fallen fast asleep.
rows.tsw_comparator: Then the sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten it for them. But Jonah had gone down into the inner part of the ship and had lain down and fallen into a deep sleep.
